#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""record_seal.py — compute/verify the sha256 seal over the frozen payload blocks
of a forecast record. Usage: python3 record_seal.py [path_to_record_json]
"""
import hashlib, json, sys

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "forecasts/london-daily-mean-2026-10-19.json"
rec = json.load(open(path))
blocks = rec["integrity"]["frozen_payload_blocks"]
payload = {b: rec[b] for b in blocks}
blob = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
digest = hashlib.sha256(blob.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
stored = rec["integrity"].get("frozen_payload_sha256")
print(f"file   : {path}")
print(f"blocks : {blocks}")
print(f"sha256 : {digest}")
if stored:
    print(f"stored : {stored}")
    print(f"match  : {stored == digest}")
